issues: Persistent cosmetic warnings: next/image aspect-ratio warning for /images/logo-blue.png & /images/logo-white.png; woff2 preload-but-not-used warning. Unchanged from prior iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 4991 lines — module split still pending (long-standing).

create_placement wraps everything in try/except and returns 500 for ANY error (including Pydantic ValidationError on bad input). Consider letting FastAPI's default 422 propagate for validation errors so clients get useful feedback; catch only DB errors.
GET /api/placements has no maximum cap on ?limit — a client could request limit=1000000. Consider clamping (e.g., min(limit, 500)).
PlacementsSection.jsx returns null when items.length === 0 — silent failure if API is down. Consider a lightweight skeleton or hiding gracefully with logging.
PlacementsSection uses `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || ''` and relies on relative /api proxy — consistent with rest of app but worth documenting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (page, home section, nav link, navigation all verified)
